name: Ganki Tengoku
source:
One night, an unskilled salaryman meets up for a date with a cute young girl. They talk, and just that way he becomes happy. They meet again at a combini. She has a part-time job there.

From there the relationship takes flight, the two of them playing together, meeting together, and being together...
Who knew his life could be this great... as soon as he finishes work he's mailing her, meeting her every single day...

And then there's a sexual electricity between them. And she says to him with a new, aroused gleam, her face beet-red with embarrassment...

"Can I sit on your face?"

Teenage Yuzuko and (you!) in sexual sixty-nine heaven.

translation:
一天晚上，一位不熟练的工薪族与一位可爱的年轻女孩约会。他们交谈，这样他就会变得快乐。他们在一个组合再次见面。她在那里有一份兼职工作。

从那时起，两人的关系开始腾飞，他们一起玩耍、一起见面、在一起……
谁知道他的生活可以这么美好……一完成工作，他就给她寄邮件，每天都和她见面……

然后他们之间就有了性电。她带着一种新的兴奋的光芒对他说道，她的脸因尴尬而涨得通红……

“我可以坐在你脸上吗？”

少年柚子和（你！）在性六十九天堂。
